title: Internal error/crash on property declared outside a class
body:
Python 3.5.1, mypy 0.3.1 and 1423a54.

Minimal code required to reproduce (I don't dispute it's an unusual case but we have code like this nonetheless):

``` python
@property
def x(self):
    return 123
```
